g.source: training observations only; initialized by finite differences, refined by integrated trajectory residuals; contacts/outliers excluded

drag.source: training observations only; initialized by finite differences, refined by integrated trajectory residuals; contacts/outliers excluded

wind.source: training observations only; initialized by finite differences, refined by integrated trajectory residuals; contacts/outliers excluded; vertical acceleration absorbed by g

restitution.source: no universal material coefficient; see per-surface measurements

magnus.source: spin-induced lift not identifiable without measured spin

spin.source: ball spin not reconstructed from a silhouette

trajectory_refinement.uncertainty: approximate local least-squares; calibration systematic error not included

selected_model.uncertainty_method: linear least-squares standard errors; correlated finite differences and calibration systematic error are not included
limitations: L3 calibration of predefined families, not autonomous code/physics induction.
Homography data remain planar even though the integrator uses XYZ vectors.
Unmeasured contact parameters stay null; contact rollout refuses guessed coefficients.
